figure_caption: Fig. 2. a) Film deposition rate on different materials and b) radicals concentration over  $\nu_{\mathrm{CF4}}$  in the plasma mixture, while Ar fraction is  $83.3\%$ . Negative values correspond to etching.
class:
a	multiple line chart
b	multiple line chart
summary:
a	The figure shows the deposition rate on various materials (Si, Al2O3, HfO2, AlN, TiN, SiO2) against the percentage of CF4 in the process.
b	The figure illustrates the concentration of F, CF2, and CF radical species against the percentage of CF4 in the process.
q1: Which materials are etched upon exposure to a plasma with more than 10% CF4 added to the plasma?
a1: The materials are TiN and SiO2
q2: Which material should be used as substrate to have the highest film deposition rate?
a2: The material that should be used as substrate is AlNx
q3: Which radical concentration has the highest dependence on CF4 concentration?
a3: The radical concentration of CF has the highest dependence on the CF4 concentration.
q4: By adding more CF4 to the plasma composition can different starting substrates be identified?
a4: An experiment can be designed such that initial thickness and final thickness can be determined after exposure to the plasma. Some materials thicknesses will decrease, others will increase.
